# Interval { #timetoalign.Interval }

```python
Interval(start=None, end=None, unit=None, /, **data)
```

A non-decreasing interval between two plain coordinates.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                                   | Description               | Default   |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|-----------|
| start  | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.time.Coordinate`) \| [TimeScalarValue](`timetoalign.core.time.TimeScalarValue`) \| None | Inclusive interval start. | `None`    |
| end    | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.time.Coordinate`) \| [TimeScalarValue](`timetoalign.core.time.TimeScalarValue`) \| None | Exclusive interval end.   | `None`    |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                 |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [TypeError](`TypeError`)   | If either endpoint is not a plain :class:`Coordinate`.                      |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If endpoint units or number types differ, or if the end precedes the start. |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [duration](#timetoalign.Interval.duration) | Return the exact non-negative interval duration. |
| [number_type](#timetoalign.Interval.number_type) | Return the common endpoint number type. |
| [unit](#timetoalign.Interval.unit) | Return the common endpoint unit. |
